_comment: MCP resource spec for the merged Founder PM hire app (supersedes #12 + #38). Phase 2 .mcpb bundle target. Draft — MCP Apps spec (Jan 2026) is young; owner to validate before locking.

resource.name: Founder PM hire
resource.description: Eight-input diagnostic for founders. Collapses the two-step 'should I hire a PM?' + 'which level?' into one verdict: stay-founder-mode, not-yet (with interim playbook), hire-apm, hire-empowered-pm, or hire-head-of-product. Each verdict comes with what good looks like and the typical cost of getting it wrong.

tools.name: founder_pm_hire_diagnose
tools.description: Deterministic. Returns the verdict + interim_playbook_id from the eight inputs. Does not call an LLM.

tools.name: founder_pm_hire_narrate
tools.description: LLM-narrated. Takes the diagnostic output and inputs, returns the three-section reading: verdict, level description (or interim playbook), wrong-fit cost.

user_inputs.description: The eight original inputs verbatim so the narration can reference specifics.

tools.name: founder_pm_hire_drift
tools.description: MCP-only (stateful). Compares the current diagnostic to a previous run and reports what shifted. Default off — requires opt-in.
tools._phase_note: Web/URL-trick versions don't expose this tool. State requires the MCP App AND user opt-in.

_open_questions: Validate ui:// URI scheme against current MCP Apps spec.
Confirm enum-with-null is acceptable in MCP outputSchema (or refactor interim_playbook_id to optional field without null).
Decide how the diagnose tool exposes the bias-toward-not-yet (early stages) and bias-away-from-head-of-product (non-heavy density) — debug logs in the tool output, or surface only in narration?
_proposed_answers: Confirmed valid. The Jan 2026 MCP Apps spec uses ui:// for embedded UI resources. 'ui://working-from-lenny/founder-pm-hire' matches the required pattern.

Recommend refactoring to omit rather than null. While 'type': ['string', 'null'] is valid JSON Schema and acceptable in MCP outputSchema, the cleaner pattern is to declare interim_playbook_id as optional (remove it from 'required', do not include it in the output when verdict does not warrant a playbook). Absent fields are unambiguous; explicit nulls add a deserialization edge case for hosts. Keep the enum values; drop the null union; mark the field optional.

Surface only in narration. Debug-style bias annotations in the diagnose tool output leak implementation detail and can confuse hosts that render tool output verbatim. The founder_pm_hire_narrate tool is the right place to explain why the bias applies. If internal testing requires visibility into the routing logic, add a _debug_trace field (prefixed _ so the Jan 2026 spec ignores it for display) that hosts can suppress in production.
